slides.headline: Claude Code is only as good as the *setup* around it.

slides.heading: Write the *CLAUDE.md* once
body: Commands, conventions, gotchas. Loaded every session.
You stop repeating yourself by day two.

slides.heading: Plan before it *types*
body: Shift+Tab into plan mode for any real change.
Read the plan, then let it build.

slides.heading: *Clear* the context between tasks
body: Stale context costs tokens and bends answers.

slides.heading: Let hooks do the chores
body: Run the formatter or tests after every edit.
The harness runs them, so they never get skipped.

slides.heading: Turn repeat work into a *skill*
body: A folder with a SKILL.md, loaded only when it fits.
Your process, written once, run every time.

slides.headline: Five habits, one calmer workflow
slides.cta: Building this for a team? Happy to compare notes.
